---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new command, flag, or behavior
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Why

What gap does this fill? Is there an upstream `terkelg/anki-markdown`
issue or an agent workflow that's awkward today?

## Proposed behavior

What command / flag / output?

```bash
anki-xml ...
```

## Alternatives

What did you try instead?

## Out of scope if requests are low

Per [`extension-policy.md`](https://github.com/master8848/Anki-import/blob/main/docs/extension-policy.md),
some features are deferred until enough requests materialize.
